purpose: Separate Paper Frame review export; no publication or source replacement.
user_authorization: User explicitly requested horizontal overlay loop, new v02 MP4, and post-render technical and visual checks.

input.role: unchanged base picture and AAC audio

output.audio: source AAC-LC mono 44.1 kHz; two-stage remux; all 9712 packet payloads SHA-256 match source v01

required_checks: all 9712 source/output AAC packet hashes identical
limitations: Source is already H.264; adding the overlay requires one new lossy video encode.
Final H.264 yuv420p MP4 has no alpha; frame pixels are composited into the picture.
audio_preservation_correction: A single ffmpeg output with -frames:v stopped muxing AAC at the last video frame and omitted 3 trailing AAC packets. The accepted two-stage pipeline encodes the overlay video-only with 6764 frames, then remuxes that video with the original source AAC to EOF using stream copy and no duration/frame limit. Verified 9712 packet payload hashes identical.

render_implementation.video_stage: H.264 encode with overlay, 6764 frames, video-only
render_implementation.audio_stage: stream-copy remux of original AAC to EOF without -t, -shortest or frame cap
